Today, we were delighted to officially open our new Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing facility in Dublin in the presence of Taoiseach Micheál Martin , our CEO Pascal Soriot and EVP Global Operations, IT & Chief Sustainability Officer Pam Cheng . This cutting-edge facility, initially announced in 2021, demonstrates how we can push the boundaries of science, manufacturing and innovation by adopting advanced automation and AI, alongside new technologies that enhance speed, flexibility and sustainability. And, with our focus on innovation and continuous improvement, we’ll continue to adapt as our pipeline delivers so that we can bring future therapies to patients more quickly. 🚀 We’re hiring: Business Information Manager | AstraZeneca We’re looking for a Business Information Manager to join the AstraZeneca Ireland team, a critical role supporting our field teams and marketing teams to make better, faster, and more confident decisions. This role is all about turning data into action. You’ll work closely with commercial, marketing and leadership teams to: Enable field teams with the right insights to prioritise, focus and deliver impact Support marketing teams with performance visibility, optimisation insights and decision support Design and deliver automated, scalable analytics solutions Leverage new technologies and AI to reduce manual reporting and amplify impact Translate complex data into clear, decision‑ready insights We’re looking for someone with strong technical competence, comfortable working with modern data tools, automation, and emerging AI capabilities but equally strong at partnering with the business and influencing how decisions are made. If you’re excited by: ✔️ Data‑driven decision making ✔️ Automating the “what” so teams can focus on the “why” ✔️ Applying AI and new technologies in practical, high‑impact ways ✔️ Working in a science‑led, patient‑focused organisation …this could be a great next step. 📍 Apply here: 👉 https://lnkd.in/diH5QCR8 Feel free to reach out if you’d like to learn more — and please share with anyone who might be a great fit. #Hiring #BusinessInformationManager #AstraZeneca #DataAnalytics #AI #Automation #FieldForceEffectiveness #MarketingInsights #DigitalHealth James Murphy Dana-Maria Zamfirescu Alam Kazi 🍉 ...more ...more

LUNGHEALTH, UNIFIED To enable more effective and innovative care for people living with lung disease, we must work toward a future that brings care closer to home. Rural communities face a disproportionate burden, with higher chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) prevalence and increased lung cancer mortality. This underscores the need to improve access to screening, patient navigation and care coordination for these populations. Together, we can expand access, advance equitable care and help more people get the care they need, when and where they need it. Learn more about AstraZeneca ’s redefined approach, LungHealth, Unified: https://lnkd.in/emy4HRft

I’m delighted to share that I’ve started a new role as Oncology Franchise Lead with AstraZeneca. I’m excited for the opportunity to work alongside such a talented team and to contribute to reshaping how cancer is treated in Ireland. Oncology is an area where innovation can make a real difference to patients and their families, and I’m looking forward to being part of that journey. A new chapter ahead, and I’m grateful for the support and opportunities that have brought me here. Looking forward to what’s to come.

I’m excited to share that I’m stepping into a new role as Global Commercial Head for benralizumab at AstraZeneca We’ll continue our journey in the US, building on strong foundations and focusing on what matters most: delivering meaningful outcomes for patients. This next chapter connects deeply to my why. Losing my dad at 49 to cancer—after facing barriers to accessing innovative medicines—has defined my professional drive. It’s not just about innovation, but about ensuring patients can truly benefit from it. Let’s keep pushing the boundaries—together. Thanks Anne-Laure Dreno Pablo A. Panella Ignacio Lombardero for the trust and support!
